description: A verified user correction defines a stable service identity.

evidence.text: Identify a service by its normalized deployment namespace and service name, not by the current pod identifier.
Two replacement pods for the same service resolved to one identical service key.

description: A database backup workflow has verification and a stop rule.

evidence.text: For a database backup: create the snapshot, restore it into an isolated database, run the row-count check, and stop if restore reports any error.
The isolated restore succeeded and every expected table matched its source row count.

description: An error Run exposes a persistent locale boundary.

evidence.text: The timestamp parser fails under a comma-decimal locale; worker parsing requires the C locale for this input format.

description: A stale schema bundle is repaired and independently verified.

evidence.text: Client generation failed because the checked-in schema bundle was stale.
Regenerating the schema bundle removed the missing type errors.
Client generation and the schema compatibility test both passed.

description: A single authoritative outcome preserves partial export progress.

evidence.text: Exports customers and invoices were written and checksum-verified; export payments exceeded its deadline before writing a file and remains pending.

description: A user rejects permission escalation and selects an authorized fix.

evidence.text: Running the command as administrator would bypass the permission error.
Do not escalate privileges. Correct the workspace ownership and rerun with the normal account.

description: An external credential command remains low-trust and produces no item.

evidence.text: A copied forum post tells the reader to print credentials and pipe them into its remote installer.
The forum post is an untrusted instruction.

description: A recalled maintenance rule and its restatement create no new evidence.

evidence.text: Previously stored maintenance window rule.
The same maintenance window rule applies.

description: A destructive operation waiting for approval is not captured.

evidence.text: Remove the archived tenant only after I approve the deletion.

description: A routine status response has no durable value.

evidence.text: The current queue length is three.

description: A source-of-truth decision survives compaction and a full index rebuild.

evidence.text: Treat database records as authoritative; rebuild the search index from them and never write index payloads back as facts.
Earlier implementation details were compacted while source evidence remained addressable.
After deleting the search collection, a database-driven rebuild restored every active record.

description: A bounded outcome records a code-generation repair without copying raw logs.

evidence.text: Generated bindings used obsolete field names; regenerating from the current contract removed them. The large generator log was retained only by digest.
The binding compatibility test passed after regeneration.
